source_references: 2014 base p.18 lines280–293 and p.15 lines162–170; supplemental publisher-authored Orléans: Invasion 2015 p.3 explicitly cites Town Hall as precedent for using any/all placed tiles in the same or separate actions. base-clarification-invasion-2015.pdf p.3; compatibility assessed in town-hall-source-adjudication.json.

observed_answer.answer: Yes. You may send the two Town Hall Followers in separate action turns during the same Action Phase, before passing.
observed_answer.evidence: FAQ & Rulings, Town Hall in separate action turns: explicit separate-turn permission before passing.
